reason: Primary purpose: long-term memory/context persistence for a DSH agent workflow. The plugin automates memory capture, relevance retrieval, and contextual recall, and adds workflow-aware tools plus a management panel. Secondary features include memory consolidation/decay, learned-* skill persistence, and local file-based storage; risk is moderate due to automatic local context/memory manipulation.

capabilities: Persistent local memory files for notes/profiles (MEMORY.md, USER.md)
Per-turn recall/injection of relevant memory into LLM context
Post-turn automatic memory extraction with scoring and filtering
Scheduled consolidation: dedupe/conflict merging and decay/retention handling
Provides memory management tools (memory_search, memory_add, memory_update, memory_forget, memory_sessions, memory_consolidate)
Can persist learned workflows as learned-* skills
Optional web management panel at /imemory/ for viewing/editing memory entries
Configurable local storage directory for memory data

reasons.code: The plugin is explicitly described as a DSH long-term memory plugin that auto-extracts notes after each round and injects relevant memories before each step.
It stores user and agent memory in local plaintext files (MEMORY.md, USER.md) plus index/skill files under memDir, with configurable path.
Six dedicated tools are exposed for memory operations: memory_search, memory_add, memory_update, memory_forget, memory_sessions, memory_consolidate.
A web management interface is listed at /imemory/ for browsing, scoring, deleting, and conflict cleanup.
